summary: Approved launch runs survive mission renames. Workspace placement uses actual step paths and supplied inputs, not proof placeholders; unresolved execution placement requires an explicit absolute workspace rather than publishing the caller cwd.

compatibility.detail: No wire or declaration changes. Automatic cwd resolution is retained only when execution placement is provably local.

manual.detail: No data migration. Supply --workspace when placement depends on values unavailable before execution.

recovery.detail: Existing runs and immutable candidate documents are unchanged.

schema.detail: No stored schema or migration change.
